subject: general
question: There is a time lag of ______ from Gujarat to Arunachal Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 hours**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India spans longitudinally from approximately 68°E to 97°E, covering a distance of about 30 degrees of longitude.
 
• Each degree of longitude corresponds to a time difference of 4 minutes.
 
• Gujarat is located near the western edge of India, while Arunachal Pradesh is located near the eastern edge.
 
• The time difference between Gujarat (western India) and Arunachal Pradesh (eastern India) is thus around 2 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Time Zones**

 
 
• Time zones are regions of the Earth that have the same standard time.
 
• They are generally centered on meridians of longitudes that are multiples of 15°.
 
• India only has one time zone (Indian Standard Time - IST), which is 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of GMT (Greenwich Mean Time).
 
 
 
• **Indian Standard Time (IST)**
 
 
• IST is the time observed throughout India and Sri Lanka.
 
• It is calculated from the Allahabad Observatory in Mirzapur (82.5°E longitude).
 
• The IST is 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of GMT.
 
 
 
• **Longitude and Time Difference**
 
 
• The Earth is divided into 360 degrees of longitude.
 
• Each degree of longitude represents a time difference of 4 minutes.
 
• When traveling eastward, time increases, and when traveling westward, time decreases.
